title: bulk_create's DEFAULT-skipping optimisation removed fields from the query's own field list, so a re-used or re-compiled insert query would silently lose columns
smell: a compile step calls `fields.remove(field)` on a list owned by the query object it is compiling
cause: An optimisation edited shared query state in place instead of a local copy.

title: IPv6 validators crashed with TypeError on non-string values (an IPv6Address object, an int) instead of reporting a validation error
smell: a validator that only special-cases one non-str type and passes everything else straight into a string parser that raises TypeError
cause: The validator assumed every value is a str.

title: Optimised multi-column prefetch built one WHERE predicate with a parameter per column per object, failing past about 500 objects on SQLite's parameter limit
smell: a composite-key IN clause whose placeholder count grows with objects x columns, with no batching against the backend's max_query_params
cause: Tested with a handful of rows on a backend without a low parameter ceiling.

title: A new cached Options property was not registered for cache expiry, so model metadata could stay stale after fields were added at runtime
smell: a new `@cached_property` on Options built from `_get_fields()` but missing from the FORWARD_PROPERTIES expiry list (the author found more already missing)
cause: Cache invalidation is a separate hand-kept list that new cached properties must be added to.

title: bulk_create with order_with_respect_to computed the next _order values with a query outside the transaction, so concurrent inserts could pick the same order values
smell: a read of the current maximum (`_order__max`) placed before the `transaction.atomic` block that does the insert
cause: Read-then-write split across the transaction boundary.

title: Accept-header ordering sorted by specificity then quality, and deleting the quality key failed no test; the area later shipped regression #36447 (lower-quality types preferred)
smell: a two-key sort whose second key can be deleted with every test still green: no test data where specificity ties and quality differs
cause: Tests used media types where the sort keys never disagree.

title: FilteredRelation objects were renamed in place while being added to a query, so the caller's FilteredRelation was changed under it
smell: a method assigns to `filtered_relation.condition` on the object it was passed instead of on a `.clone()`
cause: Mutation of an argument; the fix initially cloned at one caller instead of at the mutation site.

title: BaseCache's async methods called the base sync logic, ignoring a subclass's overridden sync method, so custom cache backends behaved differently under async
smell: `async def aget_many` reimplemented in the base class instead of delegating to `self.get_many` when a subclass overrides it
cause: The async twin of each method was a second door that skipped subclass behaviour.

title: Tasks' enqueue-on-commit only hooked the default database's commit, so a task tied to writes on another database could run before those writes committed
smell: `transaction.on_commit(...)` with no `using=`, in a feature whose writes may go to any DATABASES entry
cause: The partner write (the enqueue) was bound to the wrong transaction.

title: Database-level on_delete checks missed multi-table-inheritance parent links and DO_NOTHING, so deleting a parent row could leave a child referencing a deleted row
smell: a system check that loops over explicit relations with `not rel.auto_created`, skipping the auto-created OneToOne parent links that carry the same rule
cause: The rule was checked on declared relations only, not on every relation that can cascade.

title: A per-database DecimalField system check used a `connection` name that was never defined in the new loop, so the check would raise NameError
smell: a loop `for db in databases:` whose body uses `connection` without `connection = connections[db]`
cause: A branch no test executed.

title: ASGI script-prefix stripping matched a prefix that ends with a slash incorrectly, mis-splitting path_info
smell: a path-segment prefix check built as `script_name + "/"` without normalising a trailing slash on script_name
cause: Prefix boundary checked for one spelling of the prefix.

title: A Bcc header added by the caller would have been silently dropped from the message instead of refused
smell: `if header == "bcc": continue` inside the extra-headers loop: a caller's explicit input discarded without a word
cause: Silent fallback chosen over a loud refusal.

title: The netstring fix for cache-key collisions still let two different Vary headers with the same value produce the same cache key
smell: a key built by hashing only the values of the varied headers, with no header name in the hashed material
cause: Key material did not identify which header each value came from.

title: The FilteredRelation alias check in values() ran only for the exact alias, so a chained lookup (alias__pk) took the old path and returned wrong rows
smell: a guard keyed on `self._filtered_relations.get(name)` with the full lookup string, so any suffix after the alias bypasses it
cause: The check matched one spelling of the name instead of its first segment.

title: Adding the HTTP QUERY method left RedirectView without a query handler, so QUERY requests to a redirect got 405 while PUT/PATCH/DELETE redirected
smell: a class that defines one handler per HTTP method while a new method is added to `http_method_names` only
cause: Every per-method door had to learn the new method; one was missed in a squash.

title: JSONField key lookups crashed with ValueError for an integer-like key longer than Python's int-string limit
smell: `int(key_transform)` inside `except ValueError: continue`, with keys like "1" * 10_000 hitting sys.int_info.default_max_str_digits
cause: Hostile-size input not considered for a newly added int() parse.

title: A string-concatenation optimisation in urlize changed trailing-punctuation logic from replace to append, altering output
smell: a performance-only change that turns `trail = middle[-strip:]` into `trail.appendleft(...)`, a different operation
cause: A behaviour change rode in on a 'no functional change' optimisation.

title: A deferred-SQL shortcut matched unique and index statements alike, so removing index_together also dropped a pending unique constraint; and one clause of the match could be deleted with no test failing
smell: an early `self.deferred_sql.remove(deferred); return` shortcut taken for any matching Statement, before the normal index-drop path
cause: A shortcut skipped the general path for cases it did not own.

title: A new JSONField __in lookup chose 'compilable' over 'resolvable' values with no test telling them apart; the same PR later produced regressions #37311 and #37377
smell: `hasattr(prep_value, "as_sql")` swapped for `"resolve_expression"` with every test still passing
cause: No test distinguished the two kinds of expression.

title: Compound-query compilation was generalised to clear subquery ordering implicitly; the reviewer asked whether outer ordering survived, and a removable condition failed no test (later partly reverted)

cause: Generalised a narrow fix without tests that pin the outer ordering.

title: Propagating worker-init errors set a shared counter to -1, so a worker still initialising could read it and get worker id 0 (duplicate or invalid test databases)
smell: a shared multiprocessing counter used both as an id allocator and as a failure flag
cause: Two meanings on one shared value read by concurrent workers.

title: Named verbatim-tag parsing liberalised whitespace matching (a reviewer prompted a model and flagged it); the change shipped and regression #37450 followed

title: bulk_update's batch-size arithmetic for composite primary keys undercounted placeholders, so large batches could exceed the backend's parameter limit

title: An empty Q() filter is falsy but not None; code that turned falsy filters into None produced wrong aggregate results (this class later shipped as regression #36751)

title: A DecimalField precision check would raise TypeError if only one of max_digits/decimal_places was None

title: Skipping quantize() for integers on SQLite would have changed stored Decimal values (8 instead of 8.000) on read-back

title: Permission renames for chained RenameModel mapped codename to permission without the content type, so same-codename permissions of other models could be renamed

cause: A flag dropped in propagation changed what None means. Regression in 00c690e.

title: __in lookups on annotations returned empty querysets when given an iterator

cause: An override point's signature changed without a compatibility shim. Regression in e097e8a.

title: Saving a spatial value to a field with srid=None silently stored NULL

cause: One subtype's property assumed for the whole type. Regression in 9b8e4c6.

title: Renaming a ManyToManyField in a migration no longer renamed its table

title: path() routes defined with gettext_lazy() failed to resolve

cause: A str-only fast path received a lazy string. Regression in f920937.

title: alogin()/alogout() did not set or clear request.user when it had already been loaded, so a logged-out request could still act as the user
smell: the async twins update only `request.auser`, while the sync versions also set `request.user`
cause: Sync and async doors enforce different state. Regression in 31a43c5.

title: PBKDF2 and MD5 hashers raised UnicodeDecodeError for bytes passwords that are not valid UTF-8

cause: Decoding bytes that never needed decoding. Regression in 78fac1b.

title: get_preferred_type() preferred more specific media types even when their quality was lower

cause: Sort keys swapped; tests could not tell. Regression in c075508 (PR 19507).

title: MediaType.params lost its q key, breaking a third-party project that read it

cause: Internal attribute treated as private though callers used it. Regression in c075508.

title: Pressing Enter in an admin form clicked the filter_horizontal 'Choose all' button instead of submitting

cause: HTML default button type. Regression in 857b104 (an accessibility fix).

title: Email messages with attachments or alternatives could not be pickled (e.g. for task queues)
